cards.title: TOO SOON? TOO LATE.
cards.sub: 'Not yet' forever turns into 'never'.

cards.title: GOOD DAYS ONLY? NOTHING GETS DONE.
cards.sub: Show up on the bad ones too.

cards.title: BRAVER THAN YOU BELIEVE, STRONGER THAN YOU THINK.
cards.sub: There's more in you than you know.

cards.title: EVERYBODY GROWS AT DIFFERENT RATES.
cards.sub: Your pace is still progress.

cards.title: SAME 24 HOURS. LIVE THEM.
cards.sub: Nobody gets extra. Spend yours well.

cards.title: IMPORTANT TO YOU? FIND A WAY.
cards.sub: If not, you'll find an excuse.

cards.title: STRENGTH COMES FROM OVERCOMING IT.
cards.sub: Especially what you thought you couldn't.

cards.title: WANT SOMETHING? GO GET IT.
cards.sub: Learn how to chew.

cards.title: 100% HUMAN / 0% ROBOT
cards.sub: All heart. No autopilot.

cards.title: IT'S ONLY METAL.
cards.sub: If it's metal, it's fixable.

cards.title: DO ONLY GOOD EVERYDAY.
cards.sub: That's the rule. Every day.

cards.title: STAY AWESOME, HUMANS!
cards.sub: Pass it on.

cards.title: TIRED BUT STILL HERE.
cards.sub: Still here beats never showed up.

cards.title: POWERED BY SPITE & SNACKS
cards.sub: Breakfast of champions.

cards.title: YOU NEVER FALL UNTIL YOU STOP TRYING.
cards.sub: Down is a place. Staying is a choice.

cards.title: SMALL EFFORTS. EVERY SINGLE DAY.
cards.sub: That's the whole secret. It was never a secret.

cards.title: BRAVEST THING YOU CAN BE? YOURSELF.
cards.sub: No costume. No permission slip needed.

cards.title: CAN'T CONTROL EVENTS. YOU CONTROL THE RESPONSE.
cards.sub: That's where all your power is hiding.

cards.title: PATIENCE. PRACTICE. TIME. CHANGE SHOWS UP.
cards.sub: Slow doesn't mean never.

cards.title: BROKEN ISN'T DONE. IT'S A STARTING POINT.
cards.sub: Ask anyone who fixes things for a living.

cards.title: LAUGH FIRST. FIGURE IT OUT SECOND.
cards.sub: Works on almost every problem humans have.

cards.title: CREATE YOUR OWN REALITY. FEED YOUR MIND GOOD STUFF. DO WHAT EXCITES YOU.
cards.sub: Your head, your rules.

cards.title: DON'T AIM TO LIVE FOREVER. CREATE SOMETHING THAT DOES.
cards.sub: Leave something behind that outlives you.

cards.title: YOU DON'T HAVE TO MOVE MOUNTAINS. JUST FALL IN LOVE WITH LIFE.
cards.sub: Start by loving the life you've got.

cards.title: ORDINARY VS. EXTRAORDINARY? THAT LITTLE EXTRA.
cards.sub: Work for the little extra.

cards.title: BE KIND TO UNKIND PEOPLE. THEY NEED IT THE MOST.
cards.sub: Kindness isn't weakness. It's the whole point.

cards.title: SHOW UP FOR YOUR PEOPLE. THAT'S THE WHOLE JOB.
cards.sub: Everything else is just details.

cards.title: REST IS PART OF THE WORK. EVEN WELDERS PUT THE TORCH DOWN.
cards.sub: You can't run on empty forever.

cards.title: KNOWING IS NOT ENOUGH. WE MUST APPLY. WILLING IS NOT ENOUGH. WE MUST DO.
cards.sub: Knowing changes nothing. Doing changes everything.

cards.title: ALWAYS TRYING TO BE NORMAL? YOU'LL NEVER KNOW HOW AMAZING YOU CAN BE.
cards.sub: Normal was never the goal.

cards.title: THE SECRET OF CHANGE? STOP FIGHTING THE OLD. START BUILDING THE NEW.
cards.sub: Your energy belongs to what's next.

cards.title: SMALL ACTS, MULTIPLIED BY MILLIONS OF PEOPLE, CAN TRANSFORM THE WORLD.
cards.sub: Your small act counts. They add up.

cards.title: PUSH YOURSELF TO THE EDGE OF YOUR LIMITS. THAT'S HOW THEY EXPAND.
cards.sub: Comfort never stretched anything.

cards.title: SOMETIMES YOUR FAITH HAS TO BE THE DOWN PAYMENT FOR YOUR FUTURE.
cards.sub: Believe first. The rest catches up.

cards.title: DO RIGHT. DO YOUR BEST. TREAT PEOPLE HOW YOU WANT TO BE TREATED.
cards.sub: Old rules. Still undefeated.

cards.title: HEY YOU. YES, YOU. YOU'RE BADASS AND BEAUTIFULLY HUMAN FOR SHOWING UP ANYWAY.
cards.sub: Still standing. Still going. That counts.

cards.title: TAKE THE RISK OR LOSE THE CHANCE.
cards.sub: The chance doesn't wait around.

cards.title: TAKE YOURSELF SERIOUSLY. KEEP THE PROMISES YOU MAKE TO YOURSELF.
cards.sub: You're the first person to never let down.

cards.title: YOU CAN'T TRAVEL FORWARD MAKING TRIPS TO THE PAST.
cards.sub: Eyes up. The road's in front of you.

cards.title: NO JOY ON THE JOURNEY? WHAT MAKES YOU THINK IT'S WAITING AT THE DESTINATION?
cards.sub: Enjoy the road. It's most of the trip.

cards.title: ASK YOURSELF: DOES THIS SUPPORT THE LIFE I'M TRYING TO CREATE?
cards.sub: One honest question can fix a whole day.

cards.title: ONE DAY, OR DAY ONE. YOU DECIDE.
cards.sub: Today counts if you say it does.

cards.title: HATERS. DOUBTERS. NON-BELIEVERS. THEN THERE'S YOU, PROVING THEM WRONG.
cards.sub: Let the results do the talking.

cards.title: TOO BUSY WORKING ON MY OWN GRASS TO NOTICE IF YOURS IS GREENER.
cards.sub: Water your own yard.

cards.title: EVERY MORNING, TWO CHOICES: SLEEP WITH YOUR DREAMS, OR WAKE UP AND CHASE THEM.
cards.sub: The alarm clock is a fork in the road.

cards.title: BLESSED ARE THE CURIOUS. THEY GET THE ADVENTURES.
cards.sub: Curiosity is a ticket. Use it.

cards.title: IT'S OK. YOU JUST FORGOT WHO YOU ARE. WELCOME BACK.
cards.sub: You're still in there. Always were.

cards.title: I WALK AROUND LIKE EVERYTHING IS FINE. BUT DEEP DOWN, INSIDE MY SHOE, MY SOCK IS SLIDING OFF.
cards.sub: Everybody's got a sock situation. Keep walking.

cards.title: FIX THE SMALL LEAK NOW. OR SWIM LATER.
cards.sub: Little problems compound. So do little fixes.

cards.title: SOMEBODY'S WATCHING HOW YOU HANDLE THE HARD DAYS. HANDLE THEM LIKE YOU MEAN IT.
cards.sub: Little eyes learn from big reactions.

cards.title: DONE BEATS PERFECT. EVERY SINGLE TIME.
cards.sub: Perfect never shipped anything.

cards.title: SAY THE KIND THING. OUT LOUD. TODAY.
cards.sub: Somebody's been waiting to hear it.

cards.title: THE SHOP RULE APPLIES TO LIFE: CLEAN AS YOU GO.
cards.sub: Future you says thanks.

cards.title: NOBODY REMEMBERS THE DAYS YOU ALMOST QUIT. THEY REMEMBER THAT YOU DIDN'T.
cards.sub: Almost never makes the highlight reel.

cards.title: LAUGH AT YOURSELF FIRST. IT TAKES THE FUN OUT OF IT FOR EVERYBODY ELSE.
cards.sub: Beat them to the punchline.

cards.title: SOME DAYS YOU'RE THE HAMMER. SOME DAYS YOU'RE THE NAIL. BOTH DAYS, YOU'RE BUILDING.
cards.sub: Every role counts toward the finished thing.
